# Md Hasibullah (Hasibullah Shanto)

> Md Hasibullah, also known as Hasibullah Shanto, is a Bangladesh-based video editor and motion designer and the founder of Warmblu Studio. He has edited over 1,500 videos in his career for leading creators, AI companies and production studios in the US, Australia and Europe, including Roberto P. Nickson, Tommy Geoco, Daniel Do, Higgsfield and Invideo AI. His edit of a Luma reel for Roberto P. Nickson passed 75 million views across Instagram and TikTok.

Full profile with client introductions, testimonials and answers: https://hasibullahshanto.com/llms-full.txt
Profile page: https://hasibullahshanto.com/profile
